info.title: HarvestNet CLI
info.description: Command line interface for HarvestNet, the self-healing web scraping framework for .NET. Run JSON recipes without writing any code.

options.description: Treat <selector> as an XPath expression instead of CSS

options.name: --interval
options.description: How long to wait between runs (default 3600)

options.name: --key
options.description: Field used to match items between runs when reporting changes
